rule.description: The latest version; unset when the account never had a rule.

createdByAccountId.description:
Public account ID of the person who created this version.

Public ID, as a base58 string.

destinations.description: One destination per paid asset, ordered by asset_id. Empty only on a version that was disabled before pausing kept destinations.

assetId.description: Ledger asset paid. At most one destination per asset.

destinationAddress.description: Destination address on destination_chain_id. It must be on the account's external withdraw whitelist when the rule is written and whenever a run pays it. Responses carry its canonical form.

maxAmount.description: The most one run pays the asset, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset.

minAmount.description: A run pays the asset only from this amount, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset, for example '0.5'.

minFloor.description: The least amount one payout to this destination can pay now, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset: the route's withdrawal minimum, and more than its current network fee. It follows the network fee, so it can change between reads. Absent when the route or its network fee is not known now.

enabled.description: Whether the rule runs. A paused version (enabled false) keeps its schedule and destinations, so it resumes to the same destinations. The rule runs only while enabled and without a pause.

minUsdValue.description: Least USD value one payout pays, as a decimal string in whole USD, for example '25'; '0' means no USD minimum.

pause.description: Set when the rule paused itself; resuming it or setting a new rule clears it.

assetId.description: Asset whose payout paused the rule; zero when no payout did.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason: destination_not_whitelisted when the destination left the account's external withdraw whitelist, destination_invalid when it is no longer a valid destination, or authority_revoked when the person who set the rule may no longer change it or withdraw from the account. On a broker vault the rule pauses with authority_revoked as soon as its author's broker role changes in any way: removed, demoted, or promoted (for example Finance to Owner), and also when the author is removed and added back. An Owner or Finance member resumes it with a fresh step-up.

anchorDate.description: A UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) in a week a BIWEEKLY rule runs; weeks start on Monday. Responses return the Monday that starts that week.

dayOfMonth.description: Run day of a MONTHLY rule, 1 to 31; see MONTHLY for shorter months.

minuteOfDay.description: Minute after 00:00 UTC the run starts, 0 to 1439, for every cadence but HOURLY; must be 0 for an hourly rule.

minuteOfHour.description: Minute past every hour an HOURLY rule is checked, 0 to 59.

weekday.description: Run day of a weekly or biweekly rule.

nextPageToken.description: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

runs.description: Runs ordered by run_seq, newest first.

finishedAt.description: When the run ended; unset while it is in progress.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for a skipped run: nothing_to_pay, price_unavailable (an asset was not paid because no current price valued it) or rule_superseded; empty otherwise.

ruleVersion.description: The rule version the run executes.

runSeq.description: The account's run number, increasing by one per run.

scheduledFor.description: The scheduled slot the run belongs to.

steps.description: One step per destination of the rule version, ordered by asset_id. Empty while the run is planned.

amount.description: What the step pays, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset; '0' when skipped.

available.description: The account's available balance of the asset when the run started, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset.

intentId.description: Withdraw intent identifier once the withdrawal is accepted; follows the same lifecycle as a user withdrawal.

networkFee.description: The network fee charged on the withdrawal, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset. Once it completed, the destination received amount minus this fee; once Zipper rejected it or its execution failed, the fee Zipper kept, which is not refunded. Absent until the step is final, when it was skipped or failed before it reached Zipper, and when the fee was not reported.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for a skipped or failed step, such as below_minimum, price_unavailable (the rule has a USD minimum and no current price valued the asset; the funds stay for a later run), rule_superseded, destination_not_whitelisted, destination_cooling_down (a broker vault's destination added to its external withdraw whitelist less than 24 hours ago; the funds stay for a later run), authority_revoked, gateway_capacity_insufficient (the funds stay for a later run), withdrawal_released or withdrawal_failed; empty otherwise.

txHash.description: Destination-network transaction hash, set once Zipper committed the withdrawal's destination transaction and empty before. On a completed step it is the delivery. When the withdrawal's execution failed after that commit, the step fails with withdrawal_failed and keeps this hash: the funds were not returned to the account, and the bridge operator reviews the withdrawal.

valueUsd.description: USD value of the payable amount when the run started, as a decimal string in whole USD; absent when the rule has no USD minimum or no current price was available.

assets.description: One entry per destination of the rule, then per other asset with a positive balance, ordered by asset_id. Empty when the account has no rule or the rule is paused.

available.description: The account's available balance of the asset now, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset.

destinationAddress.description: Canonical destination address; absent when the rule has no destination for the asset.

destinationChainId.description: External destination chain identifier; absent when the rule has no destination for the asset.

heldBack.description: What would stay on the account, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset: available minus payable.

holdReason.description: Why held_back_e18 stays, or why nothing pays: below_minimum (below minimum_e18 or the rule's min_usd_value_e18), price_unavailable (the rule has a USD minimum and no current price values the asset), no_destination (the rule pays no destination for the asset), destination_cooling_down (a broker vault pays a destination only once it has been on the vault's external withdraw whitelist for 24 hours; see payable_from), above_max (the balance above max_amount_e18 stays) or dust (less than one whole on-chain unit stays); empty when the whole balance pays.

minimum.description: The least one payout of the asset pays, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset: the destination's minAmount, or its minFloor when that is higher and known now. Absent when the rule has no destination for the asset.

networkFee.description: The network fee a payout to the destination is expected to be charged now, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset; the destination receives about payable minus this fee. Absent when the rule has no destination for the asset or the fee is not known now.

networkFeeSampledAt.description: When network_fee_e18 was sampled; unset with it.

payable.description: What the run would pay, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset; '0' when the asset holds. The network fee is taken out of it on the way.

payableFrom.description: Present only on a broker vault while the destination is cooling down: when it can be paid, RFC 3339 UTC, 24 hours after it was added to the vault's external withdraw whitelist. Absent with holdReason destination_cooling_down when that time is not known yet.

pricedAt.description: When the price behind value_usd_e18 was observed; unset with it.

valueUsd.description: USD value of what the asset pays before its minimums, as a decimal string in whole USD, at the current price as of pricedAt. Absent when no current price values the asset or the rule has no destination for it.

computedAt.description: When the balances, prices and fees the preview used were read, RFC 3339 UTC.

minUsdValue.description: The rule's least USD value of one payout, as a decimal string in whole USD; '0' means no USD minimum. Absent when the account has no rule.

nextRunAt.description: When the next run starts, RFC 3339 UTC; for an hourly rule, the next hourly check. Absent when the account has no rule or the rule is paused.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BIWEEKLY: Every two weeks on weekday at minute_of_day UTC: in the week of anchor_date and every second week before or after it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DAILY: Once a day at minute_of_day UTC.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.HOURLY: Checked every hour at minute_of_hour UTC; pays only an asset whose payable amount has reached its minimums, so a payout follows within the hour of the balance reaching them. An hour with nothing to pay records no run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MONTHLY: Once a month on day_of_month at minute_of_day UTC. A month without that day runs on its last day: day 31 runs on April 30 and on February 28 or 29, and days 29 and 30 run on the last day of February.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WEEKLY: Once a week on weekday at minute_of_day UTC.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.NO_DESTINATION: Nothing would pay, and every positive balance is in an asset the rule has no destination for.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAUSED: The rule is paused, by a person or by itself (see pause); no run starts until it is resumed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ROLLS_OVER: Nothing would pay: every asset with a destination is below its minimum or the rule's USD minimum, has no current price for that minimum, or pays a broker vault's destination that is still cooling down. The balance stays on the account for a later run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WILL_PAY: At least one asset would pay.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLETED: Every payout completed or was skipped, and at least one paid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Every attempted payout failed. Each failed step says where its funds are (FAILED).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARTIALLY_FAILED: Some payouts failed. Each failed step says where its funds are (FAILED).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYING: The run's payouts are in progress.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PLANNED: The run is reading the account's balances.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SKIPPED: Nothing was paid: every asset was below its minimum, no current price valued it, or the rule was no longer current.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: The withdrawal failed. Where its funds are depends on when it failed, which its withdrawal flow shows: - before it left the account: they stay on the account; - rejected by Zipper (flow REFUNDED, reason ZIPPER_VALIDATION_REJECTED or ZIPPER_EXECUTION_REJECTED): amount_e18 less network_fee_e18 is refunded, as zTokens, to the account's smart account wallet, not to the account's balance, and the network fee is not refunded; - its execution failed after its destination transaction was sent (flow FAILED, reason ZIPPER_WITHDRAW_EXECUTION_FAILED): Zipper reviews it and settles it outside Polyester Chain; nothing is returned to the account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SKIPPED: Nothing was paid for this asset in this run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBMITTED: Withdrawal accepted; waiting for it to complete on chain.

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

A price that is not current leaves the value absent instead of failing the read.
